subject: Intro from Nimbus: Atlas Retail — demo + calendar availability
messages:
From: Natalie Rios <natalie@nimbus-int.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Atlas Retail (Inbound) — interested in a live demo

Marissa / Ben —

Quick intro: I’m Natalie, Partnerships lead at Nimbus Integrations (SI). We recently passed a warm inbound from Atlas Retail — James Holloway (copied) — who signed up on the self-serve flow and is exploring Redwood Dedicated for high-throughput inference for in-store recommendation models.

James has a few engineering and procurement questions but would like a short product walkthrough to validate latency and deployment options. I flagged team availability and suggested a short technical demo + Q&A.

Attaching a one-pager on how we typically integrate Redwood with retail stacks. James, happy to drop context and help during the call if useful.

High-level asks from James (copied from his signup):
- confirm p99 latency at 256 tokens on A100/8GB quantized variant
- options for private deployment (VPC + audit logs)
- typical lead time for Dedicated pools

Ideal window: next 48–72 hours if possible.

Thanks —
Natalie Rios
Partnerships Lead, Nimbus Integrations
Attachments: Nimbus-Intro-OnePager.pdf

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: James Holloway <james@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Natalie Rios <natalie@nimbus-int.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Atlas Retail (Inbound) — interested in a live demo

Hi James — great to meet you, and thanks Natalie for the intro.

I’m Marissa on the Solutions/Sales team at Redwood. I’d love to run a 30-minute technical demo to show: end-to-end request latency, Dedicated vs Hosted options, and how we instrument audit logs for private deployments. Ben (copied) will join for any procurement/pricing questions.

Two options to make scheduling easy:
- pick a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min
- or tell me three 30-minute windows (in your timezone) that work and we’ll pick one.

If you can share the rough scale (# of daily inference requests / concurrencies), that’ll help us choose which model variant to demo. Attaching the brief you uploaded to your signup for reference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
Attachments: Atlas-Order-Context.txt

From: James Holloway <james@atlasretail.com>

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. Calendly worked great; I picked "Thu Jul 30, 10:30 AM PT" but I’m flexible.

A bit of context on scale:
- initial pilot: ~10k inference requests/day, concurrency ~5–10
- target after rollout: 200k/day, concurrency ~50 across stores

Main priority for the demo: make sure latency and the Dedicated pool sizing approach is clear; also want to confirm redaction/data handling for PII.

If Ben could speak briefly to the procurement timeline that would be awesome.

Thanks,
James Holloway
Senior Data Engineer, Atlas Retail
